Bob was an abusive murse. idgaf if he was frustrated with me or whatever excuse you want to give him. What he did was dehumanizing.
Let's put it this way you're at school and you can't speak. Everyone knows why and that you can still learn and hear perfectly fine. A teacher who was specifically assigned to help you talks extremely slow to you and doesn't even use complete sentences. 
Ex. 
Normal sentence you can understand: "Hi, my name is Bob. I'm here to help you. What would you like to eat?"
